intro: Alumni of Badger Supports, Badger Support Network, and Badger SPILL can ask for Badger Supports updates by email here. The updates are occasional: news from the organisation, and events alumni are invited to.
review: Built 13 November 2026 at Nicholas's direction: a subscribe form for alumni email updates, shown on the Alumni page only. It follows the email-list form's pattern end to end — the same intake, the same submissions store, the same Connect queue shape — under its own form key, so alumni requests are held apart from the general email list and can be pulled on their own. It asks for a name as well as the address, which the general list does not. How a mailing-list request reaches the Google Group is still the open owner action 7 in WORK.md; this form follows the live pattern and adds no new route. The connectQueue value is a proposal, as the email-list form's own is: Connect does not yet hold a queue of that name.

questions.help: Use an email address you plan to keep, including a personal email address.

questions.review: The help is the email-list form's, kept word for word: an alumni address has to outlast a university one.
